text:
emma: had to relocate my desk last minute because plumber needed access. now my laptop is perched on the bathroom counter next to the tub. 0/10 ergonomics but 10/10 ambient waterfall noise. :sweat_smile:
kyle: omg bathtub office pics plz :rofl:
emma: https://imgur.com/a/bathdesk - yes that's a towel under the keyboard. don't judge.
arun: does ambient humidity void your laptop warranty? asking for a friend. :thinking:
jen: micro-poll: react with :bathtub: if you've ever worked from a non-bedroom spot, :laptop: for dedicated desk, :house_with_garden: for outdoor setup
ops-bot: Heads up: Do not post images with customer PII or internal logs. Please blur if any terminal windows are visible. :lock:
emma: cropped the photo and covered the terminal. thanks ops-bot. also discovered the mirror is a great second monitor for reflection... kidding. :mirror:
martha: speedtest from tub-desk (WiFi on bathroom repeater):
```
Ping: 35 ms
Download: 32.1 Mbps
Upload: 6.7 Mbps
```
video calls were fine, just had to angle the webcam to avoid soap bottles in frame. soap-shaped distractions. :soap:
arun: pro tip: keep a microfiber cloth and a small silica packet near the rig. humidity is sneaky.
emma: lesson learned: don't drink coffee over the tub. spilled and had a tiny panic. laptop survived. will probably not replicate unless plumbing strikes again. :coffee:
jen: hero move. would pay to see a follow-up: "how to WFH from bathtub without ruining your gear" guide. :book:
kyle: also, can confirm: bathtub acoustics make you sound like an old-time radio host. 10/10 podcast energy.
emma: might do a ridiculous how-to thread later. for now returning to living room desk tomorrow. cheers team! :clap:
